status: Bounded layer CPU/build passed; root main-path integration and browser acceptance pending

api.constructor: createRigidAccessoryLayer({vrm, avatarSha256, kind:'hat', manifestUrl, manifestSha256, getHairState:()=>appearance.getState()})
api.assertHairSelection: Synchronous, returns without restricting hair when no hat is equipped. Equipped mismatched descriptor throws Error with code hat-hair-incompatible and field hairStyle.
api.descriptor: {hairStyle,replacementSHA256,hairFit:{kind,id,version,sha256}}. Optional hairManifestSha256, when present, must match.
api.catalogAndManifest: Hat loading validates exact current hairEntry catalog asset/manifest/fit pins, then fetches the pinned catalog hair manifest once to verify manifest version and fit reference. No extra descriptor fields required.
api.getHairState: Synchronous callback checked after style metadata load, after asset preparation and again after head.add before commit. Callback exceptions propagate, retain old active selection and release staged clones.
api.setBodyMode: base hides active hat, dressed restores it. Logical selection and cached resources persist.
api.getState: Retains original schema and selection/status/error fields, adds kind/bodyMode/effectiveSelection/hairDependency/pinned manifestSha256. Returned hairDependency is copied.

implementation: Default paired-ear manifest contract and none/left/right/pair selections retain normal paths. Shared template/clone/dispose code supports two hat source meshes under one single selection.
Hat shell/brim share one cloned mutable material inside an actor. Separate layers/actors own separate source geometry and cloned materials.

Hat source permits two identity mesh nodes with one untextured PBR material. External buffers/textures, skins, animation, source transforms, morphs and extensions are rejected before real loader parsing.
Hat and fit resources stay inside manifest directory. Optional caller manifest SHA, mandatory fit/asset pins and exact body/hair dependency guard are enforced.
Coverage none preserves complete existing hair and head geometry. No texture rewrite, hair hiding, hair dynamics or controller changes.

legacyEar.scope: Existing actual-source runtime checks reused; unrelated publisher section excluded.
